01 / Investment approach

From a strategic foundation
to active decisions.

The challenge develops across three rounds. Each adds a new layer to the investment process, while the initial strategic allocation remains the reference portfolio.

01

Build the foundation

A diversified allocation across broad asset-class ETFs, with a defined risk budget and documented inputs.

02

Express conviction

Discretionary stock selection measured against the strategic portfolio and a tracking error budget.

03

Test the evidence

Quantitative signals and macroeconomic views, supported by research and transparent performance measurement.

Challenge framework shown above. Meridian’s investment policy and final allocation will be published after team approval.
